partiesPartySettings.description: PartySettings represents the configurable settings of a party.

allow_member_join_in_game.description: AllowMemberJoinInGame indicates if party members can join the party while the party is in a game.

allow_member_matchmaking.description: AllowMemberMatchmaking indicates if party members can queue/dequeue on behalf of the party.

allow_party_updates_in_game.description: AllowPartyUpdatesInGame indicates if the party can be updated while the party is in a game.

partiesPartyStatus.description:
PartyStatus represents the status of a party.

 - PARTY_STATUS_UNKNOWN: PARTY_STATUS_UNKNOWN indicates an unknown status.
 - PARTY_STATUS_OPEN: PARTY_STATUS_OPEN indicates the party is open for anyone to join.
 - PARTY_STATUS_FULL: PARTY_STATUS_FULL indicates the party is full and cannot accept new members.
 - PARTY_STATUS_IN_GAME: PARTY_STATUS_IN_GAME indicates the party is currently in a game.

partiesPartyVisibility.description:
PartyVisibility represents the visibility level of a party.

 - PARTY_VISIBILITY_UNKNOWN: PARTY_VISIBILITY_UNKNOWN indicates an unknown visibility.
 - PARTY_VISIBILITY_PUBLIC: PARTY_VISIBILITY_PUBLIC indicates the party is visible to everyone.
 - PARTY_VISIBILITY_PRIVATE: PARTY_VISIBILITY_PRIVATE indicates the party is private.
 - PARTY_VISIBILITY_INVITE_ONLY: PARTY_VISIBILITY_INVITE_ONLY indicates the party is visible by invite only.
 - PARTY_VISIBILITY_FRIENDS_ONLY: PARTY_VISIBILITY_FRIENDS_ONLY indicates the party is only visible to friends.

limit.description: Number of results returned. The maximum allowed is 50, defaults to 10 if not provided.

metadata_filters.description: Metadata filters. IMPORTANT: Only populate value or a single strongly typed value field (bool_value, int_value, double_value, string_value) inside each filter to ensure correct behavior.

offset.description: Number of results to skip from the start of the result set

field.description: Field on which the results are to be sorted

order.description: Order of sorting. Valid values - asc, desc

protobufNullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.
